Card Q&A.q: During my next turn after this card's security effect was activated, does it apply to newly played Digimon and Digimon moved from the breeding area to the battle area?

Effect: [Main] 1 of your Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn.
Security Effect: [Security] All of your Digimon gain ＜Security Attack +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card) until the end of your next turn.
